text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Here, Pandora-san. I fixed that frayed 
seam you asked me about!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it looks super pretty! As expected 
of Kuu-chan-senpai~~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. Feel free to rely on me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then! You have today off, 
right? I have one more favor to ask, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Come hang out with me~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Strong Top Coat' is so cute~! I 
didn't know they made tinted top coats!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yep♡ It protects my nails super well, and 
my nail polish lasts way longer too~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's a purchase for you~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I heard the hand massages here are suuuper 
good!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright, have a safe trip! While I wait, 
maybe I'll take a walk around—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No wa~y♡ We're doing it together~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Howa... Howawawa! M-My fingers are going 
all fluffy~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Work is done. Stepping out to buy dinner—

text_block_list.name: Craft & Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hafuu~~~.
choice_data_list: It's kind of... squishy, isn't it...?
It's kind of... squishy, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fue? Ahhh~, Trainer-san~~. That's 
righttt~... The massage was pure heaven—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still... Pandora-san, was this really 
okay? We just had fun shopping and felt 
all relaxed...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Because—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Thanks as always, Ku-chan-senpai! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eeehhh~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, surprise: massive success☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ku-chan-senpai would mend clothes for me 
and iron them, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like the academy's mom, y'know? Just 
wanted to give a little something back♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that paper bag earlier had top coat in 
it. Doing detailed work ruins your nails, 
right? So—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uuu... Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: You're too good of a kid~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You think so too, right, Trainer!? They're 
so magnificent... and so thoughtful...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, that is way too cute...
choice_data_list: You really care about it, don't you?
You really care about it, huh?
Surprises do make you happy, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, that is way too cute...
choice_data_list: You really care about it, don't you?
You really care about it, huh?
Surprises do make you happy, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuu! I'm sorry, Pandora-san! I must seem 
totally weird right now...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That means our love is mutual! ♡ 
Let's hang out again tomorrow then! ♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Of course! Tomorrow, the day 
after, whenever!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's spend lots of time together, 
Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's not weird at all~. If anything, it's 
adorbs♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Really? Ehehe... Then next, let's go 
somewhere you want to go, Pandora-san!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to give you so, sooooo much 
in return for your thank-you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not at aaall! I wanna be spoiled even 
more♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Homework, classroom duty... And I'd looove 
it if you did my laundry too~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-We gotta do it right! I'll help you out, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd rely on me that much... 
Ugh... I'll try even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Ku-chan senpai's being such a 
crybaby today♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm just so happyyy! Thank you so 
muuuuch, Pandora-saaan!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it kinda makes me feel all 
fidgety~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you don't like it? Am I not allowed 
to spoil myself?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
!! That's not true at all! You can pamper 
yourself with me all you want~~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's right~. I was always just thinking 
about what I could do for them...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well then, next time will be an even 
bigger surprise~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I might cry again— But thank you, 
Pandora-san!
